title: Exfoliate To De-Tan Niacinamide Body Scrub

details.description:
Sun, sweat and daily exposure can leave your skin looking dull, rough and uneven.
Fiama De-Tan Body Scrub is your joyful reset—designed to gently exfoliate, visibly reduce tan and bring back your skin’s natural glow.
This advanced scrub blends the best of science and sensorial care. The powerful combination of 1% Niacinamide helps improve skin tone, while 1% Salicylic Acid works beneath the surface to cleanse pores and smooth rough texture. Complementing this is a 13% blend of exfoliating beads that physically polish the skin, removing dead cells and tan buildup to reveal smooth, brighter skin.
Unlike harsh scrubs that leave skin dry and tight, Fiama’s formula is enriched with Vitamin F, known for its moisturising and skin-comforting properties. The result? Skin that feels clean, soft and nourished, not stripped.
Every shower becomes a mood-lifting ritual with Fiama’s comforting gourmet fragrance, transforming everyday exfoliation into a sensorial escape.
Use it 2–3 times a week, focusing on sun-exposed areas like the neck, elbows and knees, to maintain smooth, radiant and even-looking skin.
Because glowing skin should feel as good as it looks. Fiama De-Tan Body Scrub — exfoliate, detan and glow, the happy way.
details.usageInstructions:
Scoop it! Take a happy handful of scrub in your palms
Scrub it! Gently massage in circular motions over wet skin
Renew it! Rinse it off to reveal smooth & nourished skin

details.description:
Rough, bumpy skin on the legs - often called "strawberry skin" - can make skin look uneven and feel less smooth, even after shaving. Fiama Strawberry Skin Polishing Body Scrub is crafted to gently exfoliate and polish the skin, helping reduce the visible appearance of bumps for smoother-looking legs.
This advanced formula blends enzymatic, chemical and physical exfoliation for effective yet gentle results. Papain Enzyme is known to work on the skin’s surface to dissolve dead skin cells through mild enzymatic exfoliation. A 13% blend of multiple exfoliating beads physically polishes the skin, smoothing rough texture and pore buildup.
Regular exfoliation also plays a key role in pre-shave care. By helping keep pores clear, this scrub supports smoother shaving and helps reduce the chances of ingrown hair— with 89% of users agreeing it helped when used before shaving in a consumer study conducted in Dec 2025.
Unlike harsh scrubs, Fiama’s formula is designed to be skin-comforting and nourishing, making it suitable for all skin types. Each use leaves skin feeling soft, polished and refreshed—never over-scrubbed.
Elevate your shower routine with Fiama’s refreshing aqua fragrance, inspired by exotic Japanese Hokkaido Milk, Sea Minerals and Blueberry. Clean, fresh and mood-lifting, it turns exfoliation into a feel-good ritual.
Use 2–3 times a week, focusing on strawberry-prone areas on the legs, to enjoy smoother, more refined skin over time.
Fiama Strawberry Skin Polishing Body Scrub — smooth it out, feel good with Fiama.
